Amounts in NIS thousand as printed (members = count; fee rates = percent). Negative values printed in parentheses are kept negative. A dash in a table is recorded as value null with a note.

Per-fund-type tables: segment pension_new = קרנות פנסיה חדשות with comprehensive (מקיפה) and general (כללית) as separate columns (fund_type), pension_veteran = קרן פנסיה ותיקה ה.ע.ל, provident = savings/compensation, investment, child, study funds and "other" central funds (fund_type), total = column "סך הכל" (pension + provident). sub = population (active / inactive / active_and_inactive / recipients / total). No aggregate across columns was calculated.

Windows: in the per-fund-type tables, aum and members are instant at the balance date; flows, management fees and fee rates are cumulative from 1 January (q in Q1, ytd in Q2/Q3, fy in annual reports). Stand-alone three months of Q2/Q3 appear only in the income statement and the operating-segments note.

Segment note (ביאור מגזרי פעילות): provident = מגזר הגמל, pension = מגזר הפנסיה, pension_new / pension_veteran = split of the pension segment, total = whole company. Income-statement facts have segment total.

selling_and_marketing_expenses = "עמלות, הוצאות שיווק והוצאות רכישה אחרות": printed net of capitalised acquisition commissions (change in deferred acquisition costs) and including amortisation of deferred acquisition costs. general_and_administrative_expenses = "הוצאות הנהלה וכלליות" as printed (net of amounts classified to commissions).

Extra rows kept for reconciliation: service_revenue (הכנסות משירותי/מדמי ניהול ותפעול), investment_income, total_revenue, finance_expenses, income_tax, net_profit, other comprehensive income and total comprehensive income before tax.
